name: M.308 210 FCG (MAXIMUS, 210 gr)

ballisticCoefficients.note: G1 BC, printed ".558 (O89)". Marked (O89): Oehler 89 system. Page footer: the coefficient numbers are confirmed by independent testing and by the Oehler 89 system. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

G7 BC, printed ".279 (O89)". Marked (O89): Oehler 89 system. Page footer: the coefficient numbers are confirmed by independent testing and by the Oehler 89 system. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

sources.note: Page 5, MAXIMUS Bullets: Caliber .308, Grains 210, Minimum Required Twist 1-9", Part Number M.308 210 FCG, G1 BC .558 (O89), G7 BC .279 (O89), OAL 1.638", BULLET PROJECTION .785"

note: Bullet projection (from the SealTite band to the tip, page footnote) printed: .785". The same G1 .558 and G7 .279 are printed for M.416 325.
